terms: Every price on this page is a season rental for November 14 to December 12, 2026: the display is delivered, set up, looked after and taken down by our crew, then comes back to our shop.
Travel is a single $1,000 charge for the whole order ($500 for the install trip and $500 for the takedown trip), however many displays you add.
Each display runs on a standard 120V outlet. Timers and long extension cords are extra only if they are needed, $500 at most, assuming power is close to the displays.
Sizes are approximate and most pieces can be made larger or smaller. HST is extra.
A 50% deposit reserves the displays. Proof of insurance ($5 million per occurrence, with the City named as additional insured) follows once the quote is approved and the deposit is in.
